A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CORDIAL study and contain readable main text, 12 tables, four figures, Appendices A-G, and prompt templates. Content can be matched reliably across section changes and table relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 12 MLLMs, classifier comparisons, coherence-relation verification, and prompting and fine-tuning experiments, including appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark, verification, prompting, and fine-tuning results in its main text and appendices.

M1.justification: CORDIAL's task construction, CLIP-based MLP classifier, prompting procedures, and Llama 3.2 fine-tuning remain unchanged. Corrections to punctuation in displayed prompt templates do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate DisRel, Tweet Subtitles, and CLUE in single-label and multi-label settings, covering the same three discourse domains. Unified cross-domain evaluation remains future work.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same 12 MLLMs, CLIP classifier, and random-guess baselines where reported. Verification retains GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2.

E3.justification: The splits, sample counts, F1 and accuracy metrics, few-shot example counts, preprocessing, response filtering, and training schedules are unchanged in Sections 4.2-4.3 and Appendices A-F.

E4.justification: The prompting comparisons, fine-tuning analysis in Figure 3 and Tables 8-11, and per-relation bias analysis are retained. The new cross-domain discussion introduces no transfer experiment or robustness test.

E5.justification: Appendix B retains the instruction to use random seed 42 wherever possible. Neither version adds repeated-run information, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance testing.

E6.justification: Prediction, verification, and fine-tuning results match after accounting for table reordering. For example, DisRel CLIP Macro F1 remains 0.733 in Table 2, and fine-tuned Llama's zero-shot Macro F1 remains 0.625 in Table 8.

T1.justification: The coherence-relation definitions and theoretical framing in Sections 3.2-3.3 remain unchanged. No mathematical definition, formal assumption, theorem, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: CORDIAL evaluates multimodal discourse understanding, MLLMs struggle relative to classifier baselines, and coherence-aware fine-tuning can improve performance.

C2.justification: v1's limitation concerning the absence of a unified coherence taxonomy is moved and expanded in v2 Section 5.2. The discussion connects this issue to prior cross-domain adaptation research and proposes unified taxonomies, adding an untested expectation that distribution changes would challenge classifiers more than MLLMs. Single-turn and English-only limitations remain.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the GitHub repository link with the CORDIAL project-site link, changing the documented resource entry point. Implementation, hyperparameter, hardware, and data-processing disclosures otherwise remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in resource contents.

R1.justification: v2 adds Bourgonje and Demberg (2024), Generalizing across languages and domains for discourse relation classification, to contextualize cross-domain generalization. Other bibliography corrections concern already cited works, and the broader novelty positioning is retained.

P1.justification: v1 Section 4.4 becomes part of a separate Findings and Implications section, divided into Main Results and Discussion, and the conclusion is renumbered. Local wording edits and corrections to prompt delimiters and quotation marks accompany this limited reorganization.

P2.justification: The verification table moves from page 6, Table 3, to page 7, Table 5. Tweet Subtitles and CLUE single-label prediction tables are consequently renumbered from 4/5 to 3/4, with surrounding text reflow. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves organization and develops v1's brief taxonomy limitation into a more informative cross-domain discussion with a relevant citation. Prompt-notation corrections also improve clarity. Experimental support remains unchanged, and the added assertion of greater MLLM robustness is untested, limiting the benefit to presentation and contextualization.
